database.stem: Mr. Smith wants you to know that he will be ------- job applicants all day on Thursday, and that all enquiries should be directed to his secretary.
database.raw_text:
Mr. Smith wants you to know that he will be ------- job applicants all day on
Thursday, and that all enquiries should be directed to his secretary.
(A) interview
(B) interviews
(C) interviewed
(D) interviewing
database.explanation:
job applicants充当interview的宾语，且横线前有be，故选
(D) interviewing。将来进行时 (will be doing) 用于描述主语确信的、
将来肯定会发生的事情。
